description: Dead or Fled: fleeing at the end (80 → 40) and at 25% or less of starting strength (90 → 45) are both half, rounded up; fled (70) is full. Domination as counts with the scenario's own values: 2 quarters × 25, 1 double strength × 10, 1 uncontested × 15 = 75. Strategic Locations isn't in the scenario, so the banked total isn't worked out. 155 + 75 = 230.
